watch.summary: The creator reacts to a pro Valorant player greedily going for an orb only to get trapped and instantly eliminated by an enemy Vyse.

beats.what: Creator notes Boostio's stats and role as IGL.
Boostio slides down stairs towards the orb area.
Boostio triggers the Vyse wall and trap abilities.
Boostio is trapped and instantly killed.
Creator laughs, shouting that greed for the orb cost him his life.

watch.author: pro_player_in_footage
watch.key_line: That's gonna cost him his life! He wanted that orb!
watch.why: The creator's animated play-by-play turns a pro player's greedy mistake into a funny moment. Without familiarity with Valorant's abilities and esports scene, the clip loses much of its comedy.
